# OMOCHI TOUCH

> A browser-local art playground featuring original photographs of OMOCHI, a white West Highland White Terrier. Art direction and credit: 鎌・くらんぽのクランポック.

- [Official app](https://djnaoyaman.github.io/omochi-touch/): Select OMOCHI photos, original geometric backgrounds and colors; arrange, resize and rotate photographs; export a still PNG.
- [Full site guide](https://djnaoyaman.github.io/omochi-touch/llms-full.txt)
- [Credit](https://djnaoyaman.github.io/kuranpo/)

Artwork is original and inspired by art movements, not an official museum or organization collaboration. Photos retain the original dog's identity through non-generative masking and color correction. Compositions remain in the visitor's browser. Embedded music comes from YouTube; availability varies. The Google Analytics tag loads on page open. Visitors can disable collection for their browser; prior declined preferences are respected, while the tag file itself still loads. Typed text, photograph contents and compositions are not sent. This file is an optional discovery aid, not a guarantee of AI indexing or citation.
